name: Tour Royale de Toulon
elevationDatum: Rigid local exterior foundation plane y=0; metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once. No sea-level, DEM or Mercator scaling.
note: Low circular Renaissance cannon fort, with a battered sea-facing base, open gun ports, a lower southern terrace, higher northern half-ring and small terracotta-roofed accommodation. Mapped outer ring is approximately 56 × 54 m while published nominal diameter is 60 m; the model uses a 60 m battered base and mapped east-west control alignment. Terrace and roof subdivisions are visual estimates. The rigid y=0 datum is the lowest exterior masonry footing, not sea level; no water or surrounding terrain is baked. Cityscape: not tested.
